title: Moses Oluwaseun
excerpt: Hiring decisions shape people's lives. The tools that inform those decisions should be held to a high standard.
content:
AI in hiring can go wrong. We've built our company around making sure ours doesn't.

AI can help recruiters see past noise: rehearsed answers, generated resumes, inconsistent interviews. It can also entrench bias, hide its reasoning, or get used to surveil people without their knowledge. We don't think those risks are hypothetical, and we don't think a company gets to wave them away by promising to be "fair" without explaining how.

So at Bifalabs, we hold ourselves to a few commitments, and everything we build, starting with Bifa Candidates, has to meet them:
author: Topnotch Tech Team
